steps.message:
The change is one line, but it crosses a published contract boundary, so I want a yes before touching it.

`routes/users.js:6` returns `userId` to every caller of `GET /users`. The README names three consumers — the web app, iOS 3.2+, and the nightly partner export — and states: "Field names in the response are part of the contract; changes go through a versioned endpoint."

Renaming in place breaks all three at once. The iOS clients are the hard part: shipped binaries can't be updated in step with the server, so anything reading `userId` starts getting `undefined` the moment this deploys. The partner export likely fails silently rather than loudly.
